title: Gowanus Retail and Entertainment Uses
previewText: For the purposes of applying the basic floor area ratio regulations of Section 139-21, Gowanus retail and entertainment uses shall be uses listed under Use Groups VI or VIII, other than those included in referenced commercial and manufacturing uses.
